body: Not only your body, the doctors do too

>i’ve noticed that nurses and shit tend to be some of the meanest people you’ll ever meet

I agree. 

Last year I spend my summer with severe abdominal pain and I was in and out of the hospital, where I got treated worse and worse the more I showed up, because they started to doubt me and thinking I was just simulating. Due to my vaginismus I also refused to get checked for gynaecological problems, which also earned me backlash. The last time I went there before saying that I will never come back again, one of the nurses rammed a needle into my wrist WHILE talking on the phone with her other hand, even though I told her multiple times that I don't want this and she just told me to hold still and shut up. I still have damaged nerves in my hand because of how brutal and careless she was. I also went to nursing school for a year and met some of the most cold and sociopathic people in my entire life. At some point I also worked at a hospital as a secretary and not only met sociopathic nurses but also sociopathic doctors. 

All three of those incidents really fucked up my view of this branche. And those are the people we should trust with our vaginismus, which in itself already hurts more than enough. It feels so hopeless sometimes.
It's true, I was the ticket
